homeIntro.en: Mohammed Abba Isa has spent more than a decade advocating for persons with disabilities. From his early leadership in Yobe to national public service, his work has focused on access to education, livelihoods and equal opportunity.
homeIntro.ha: Mohammed Abba Isa ya shafe fiye da shekaru goma yana fafutukar kare muradun masu nakasa. Daga jagorancinsa na farko a Yobe zuwa hidimar ƙasa, aikinsa ya mayar da hankali kan samun ilimi, hanyoyin dogaro da kai da damar daidaito.
homeIntro.yo: Mohammed Abba Isa ti lo ohun tó ju ọdún mẹ́wàá lọ láti polongo ẹ̀tọ́ àwọn aláàbò ara. Láti ìdarí rẹ̀ ní ìbẹ̀rẹ̀ ní Yobe sí iṣẹ́ ìjọba orílẹ̀-èdè, iṣẹ́ rẹ̀ ti dá lórí àǹfààní ẹ̀kọ́, ọ̀nà ìgbésí ayé àti àǹfààní dọ́gba.
homeIntro.ig: Mohammed Abba Isa ejirila ihe karịrị afọ iri kwado ndị nwere nkwarụ. Site na nduzi mbụ ya na Yobe ruo n'ọrụ ọha na mba, ọrụ ya lekwasịrị anya na ohere agụmakwụkwọ, ụzọ ibi ndụ na ohere nhata.

subjectParagraphs.en: Mohammed Abba Isa’s path to national public service began in disability advocacy in Yobe, where he served as the first chairman of the state chapter of JONAPWD. Appointed Senior Special Assistant to the President on Disability Matters on 9 November 2023, his portfolio was later described as Special Needs and Equal Opportunities.
subjectParagraphs.ha: Hanyar Mohammed Abba Isa zuwa hidimar ƙasa ta fara ne da fafutukar masu nakasa a Yobe, inda ya zama shugaban farko na reshen JONAPWD na jihar. An naɗa shi Babban Mataimaki na Musamman ga Shugaban Ƙasa kan Harkokin Nakasa a ranar 9 Nuwamba 2023; daga baya an bayyana fannin aikinsa da Buƙatu na Musamman da Daidaiton Dama.
subjectParagraphs.yo: Ọ̀nà Mohammed Abba Isa sí iṣẹ́ ìjọba orílẹ̀-èdè bẹ̀rẹ̀ pẹ̀lú ìpolongo fún àwọn aláàbò ara ní Yobe, níbi tí ó ti ṣiṣẹ́ gẹ́gẹ́ bí alága àkọ́kọ́ ti ẹ̀ka JONAPWD ti ìpínlẹ̀ náà. A yàn án gẹ́gẹ́ bí Olùrànlọ́wọ́ Àkànṣe Àgbà fún Ààrẹ lórí Ọ̀rọ̀ Aláàbò Ara ní 9 Oṣù kọkànlá 2023; lẹ́yìn náà a pe àgbègbè iṣẹ́ rẹ̀ ní Àìní Àkànṣe àti Àǹfààní Dọ́gba.
subjectParagraphs.ig: Ụzọ Mohammed Abba Isa si banye n'ọrụ ọha na mba malitere na nkwado ndị nwere nkwarụ na Yobe, ebe ọ bụ onye isi mbụ nke ngalaba JONAPWD steeti ahụ. A họpụtara ya dịka Onye Enyemaka Pụrụ Iche Ukwu nye Onye isi ala n'Okwu Nkwarụ na 9 Nọvemba 2023; e mesịrị, a kpọrọ ngalaba ọrụ ya Mkpa Pụrụ Iche na Ohere Nhata.

subjectParagraphs.en: He holds honours and master’s degrees in Public Administration from the University of Maiduguri, completing his master’s in 2017. In July 2024, he supported inclusive teacher education at a public hearing for the proposed Federal College of Education (Special), Dukku.
subjectParagraphs.ha: Ya samu digirin farko na honours da digiri na biyu a fannin Gudanar da Harkokin Jama’a daga Jami’ar Maiduguri, inda ya kammala digiri na biyu a 2017. A Yuli 2024, ya goyi bayan ilimin malamai mai shigar da kowa a zaman sauraron ra’ayoyin jama’a kan Kwalejin Ilimi ta Tarayya (ta Musamman), Dukku, da ake son kafawa.
subjectParagraphs.yo: Ó ní oyè honours àti master’s nínú Ìṣàkóso Ìjọba láti University of Maiduguri, ó sì parí master’s rẹ̀ ní 2017. Ní Oṣù keje 2024, ó ṣètìlẹ́yìn fún ẹ̀kọ́ olùkọ́ tó kó gbogbo ènìyàn sí ní ìgbọ́ràn gbangba fún Federal College of Education (Special), Dukku, tí a dabaa.
subjectParagraphs.ig: O nwere nzere honours na master’s na Nchịkwa Ọha site na University of Maiduguri, wee mechaa master’s ya na 2017. Na Julaị 2024, ọ kwadoro ọzụzụ ndị nkuzi gụnyere mmadụ niile na nnọkọ ịnụ echiche ọha maka Federal College of Education (Special), Dukku, a tụrụ.

subjectParagraphs.en: Through his office, he has helped connect participants with disabilities to SMEDAN business-skills training and startup support. His engagement with FHA Mortgage Bank also brought attention to livelihood opportunities, including the stall-allotment ceremony reported in May 2025, where the bank handed over allocation documents.
subjectParagraphs.ha: Ta ofishinsa, ya taimaka wajen haɗa mahalarta masu nakasa da horon ƙwarewar kasuwanci da tallafin fara sana’a na SMEDAN. Hulɗarsa da FHA Mortgage Bank ta kuma jawo hankali ga damar samun abin dogaro da kai, ciki har da bikin rabon rumfuna da aka ruwaito a Mayu 2025, inda bankin ya miƙa takardun rabon.
subjectParagraphs.yo: Nípasẹ̀ ọ́fíìsì rẹ̀, ó ti ṣèrànwọ́ láti so àwọn olùkópa aláàbò ara pọ̀ mọ́ ìdánilẹ́kọ̀ọ́ ọgbọ́n òwò àti ìrànlọ́wọ́ ìbẹ̀rẹ̀ òwò SMEDAN. Ìbáṣepọ̀ rẹ̀ pẹ̀lú FHA Mortgage Bank tún fa àfiyèsí sí àwọn àǹfààní ọ̀nà ìgbésí ayé, pẹ̀lú ayẹyẹ pípín ṣọ́ọ̀bù tí a ròyìn ní Oṣù karùn-ún 2025, níbi tí bánkì ti fi ìwé ìpín lé wọn lọ́wọ́.
subjectParagraphs.ig: Site n'ụlọ ọrụ ya, o nyerela aka jikọta ndị sonyere nwere nkwarụ na ọzụzụ nkà azụmahịa na nkwado mmalite azụmahịa SMEDAN. Nsonye ya na FHA Mortgage Bank mekwara ka a ṅaa ntị n'ohere ụzọ ibi ndụ, gụnyere emume nkesa ụlọ ahịa a kọrọ na Mee 2025, ebe ụlọ akụ ahụ nyefere akwụkwọ nkesa.

creatorParagraphs.en: I’m Jerry Zachary Bannister, a statistician, data scientist and researcher in Statistics at Abubakar Tafawa Balewa University, Bauchi. I work as a Statistician in the university’s Directorate of Academic Planning and Quality Assurance and run JJMB Datascience Hub, supporting researchers, organisations and businesses with data analysis and software.
creatorParagraphs.ha: Ni ne Jerry Zachary Bannister, masanin ƙididdiga, masanin kimiyyar bayanai kuma mai bincike a fannin Ƙididdiga a Jami’ar Abubakar Tafawa Balewa, Bauchi. Ina aiki a matsayin Masanin Ƙididdiga a Sashen Tsare-tsaren Ilimi da Tabbatar da Inganci na jami’ar, kuma ina gudanar da JJMB Datascience Hub, ina tallafa wa masu bincike, ƙungiyoyi da kasuwanci da nazarin bayanai da manhajoji.
creatorParagraphs.yo: Èmi ni Jerry Zachary Bannister, onímọ̀ ìṣirò, onímọ̀ sáyẹ́ǹsì dátà àti olùwádìí ní Ìṣirò ní Abubakar Tafawa Balewa University, Bauchi. Mo ń ṣiṣẹ́ gẹ́gẹ́ bí Onímọ̀ Ìṣirò ní Ẹ̀ka Ìṣètò Ẹ̀kọ́ àti Ìmúdájú Dídára ti yunifásítì náà, mo sì ń darí JJMB Datascience Hub, tí ó ń ran àwọn olùwádìí, àjọ àti ilé-iṣẹ́ lọ́wọ́ pẹ̀lú ìtúpalẹ̀ dátà àti sọ́fitiwia.
creatorParagraphs.ig: Abụ m Jerry Zachary Bannister, ọkachamara ọnụ ọgụgụ, ọkà mmụta data na onye nyocha na Ọnụ Ọgụgụ na Abubakar Tafawa Balewa University, Bauchi. Ana m arụ ọrụ dịka Ọkachamara Ọnụ Ọgụgụ na Ngalaba Atụmatụ Agụmakwụkwọ na Nkwenye Ịdị Mma nke mahadum ahụ ma na-elekọta JJMB Datascience Hub, na-akwado ndị nyocha, òtù na azụmahịa site na nyocha data na sọftụwia.

creatorParagraphs.en: My work in statistics, machine learning and AI aims to create practical tools that solve pressing local problems and make complex information easier to use.
creatorParagraphs.ha: Aikina a fannin ƙididdiga, koyon na’ura da AI yana nufin samar da kayan aiki masu amfani da za su magance matsalolin cikin gida masu buƙatar kulawa cikin gaggawa, kuma su sauƙaƙa amfani da bayanai masu sarƙaƙiya.
creatorParagraphs.yo: Iṣẹ́ mi nínú ìṣirò, ẹ̀kọ́ ẹ̀rọ àti AI ní àfojúsùn láti ṣe ohun èlò ìṣe tí yóò yanjú ìṣòro pàjáwìrì ní àgbègbè wa, kí ó sì jẹ́ kí ìsọfúnni tó díjú rọrùn láti lò.
creatorParagraphs.ig: Ọrụ m na ọnụ ọgụgụ, mmụta igwe na AI bu n'obi imepụta ngwa bara uru nke na-edozi nsogbu mpaghara chọrọ nlebara anya ngwa ngwa ma na-eme ka ozi dị mgbagwoju anya dịkwuo mfe iji.

creatorParagraphs.en: As a wheelchair user, I believe AI can help disabled people live with greater independence, understand information, communicate, learn and access opportunities. My goal is to build accessible, affordable tools shaped by disabled people’s needs and choices, giving them more control over their everyday lives.
creatorParagraphs.ha: A matsayina na mai amfani da keken guragu, na yi imanin cewa AI na iya taimaka wa masu nakasa su ƙara dogaro da kansu, su fahimci bayanai, su sadarwa, su koya kuma su samu dama. Burina shi ne gina kayan aikin da sauƙin amfani da araha, waɗanda buƙatu da zaɓin masu nakasa suka tsara, domin su ƙara samun ikon tafiyar da rayuwarsu ta yau da kullum.
creatorParagraphs.yo: Gẹ́gẹ́ bí ẹni tí ń lo àga alágbèéká, mo gbà pé AI lè ran àwọn aláàbò ara lọ́wọ́ láti gbé ayé pẹ̀lú òmìnira sí i, lóye ìsọfúnni, báni sọ̀rọ̀, kọ́ ẹ̀kọ́ àti rí àǹfààní. Àfojúsùn mi ni láti kọ́ ohun èlò tí ó rọrùn láti lò, tí owó rẹ̀ kò ga, tí àìní àti àṣàyàn àwọn aláàbò ara ń darí, kí wọ́n lè ní àkóso sí i lórí ìgbésí ayé wọn ojoojúmọ́.
creatorParagraphs.ig: Dịka onye na-eji oche nkwagharị, ekwere m na AI nwere ike inyere ndị nwere nkwarụ aka ibi ndụ nwere nnwere onwe karị, ịghọta ozi, ikwurịta okwu, ịmụ ihe na inweta ohere. Ebumnuche m bụ iwulite ngwa dị ọnụ ala, mmadụ niile nwere ike iji, nke mkpa na nhọrọ ndị nwere nkwarụ na-akpụzi, na-enye ha ikike karị ịchịkwa ndụ ha kwa ụbọchị.

creatorParagraphs.en: For this project, I used Python and scikit-learn to highlight distinctive words with TF-IDF and find recurring themes with NMF.
creatorParagraphs.ha: A wannan aikin, na yi amfani da Python da scikit-learn don nuna kalmomin da ke bambanta rubuce-rubuce ta TF-IDF da gano jigogin da ke maimaituwa ta NMF.
creatorParagraphs.yo: Fún iṣẹ́ yìí, mo lo Python àti scikit-learn láti fi àwọn ọ̀rọ̀ tó ń yà àkọsílẹ̀ sọ́tọ̀ hàn pẹ̀lú TF-IDF àti láti rí àwọn àkòrí tí ń tún wá pẹ̀lú NMF.
creatorParagraphs.ig: Maka ọrụ a, ejiri m Python na scikit-learn gosipụta okwu na-ekewapụ akwụkwọ site na TF-IDF ma chọpụta isiokwu na-emegharị site na NMF.

title.ha: Aikin ƙasa domin shigar da kowa
title.yo: Iṣẹ́ orílẹ̀-èdè fún ìkó gbogbo ènìyàn sí
title.ig: Ọrụ mba maka nsonye mmadụ niile

text.en: His presidential appointment placed disability inclusion across government at the centre of his remit. The State House asked him to bring the needs and perspectives of persons with disabilities into federal policies and programmes, working with state authorities and the National Commission for Persons with Disabilities. This gives his advocacy a role in how public institutions plan for access and opportunity.
text.ha: Naɗinsa a fadar shugaban ƙasa ya sanya shigar da masu nakasa cikin harkokin gwamnati a tsakiyar aikinsa. Fadar ta umarce shi ya sa buƙatu da ra’ayoyin masu nakasa cikin manufofi da shirye-shiryen tarayya, tare da hukumomin jihohi da Hukumar Masu Nakasa ta Ƙasa. Wannan ya ba fafutukarsa rawa wajen yadda hukumomin jama’a ke tsara samun dama.
text.yo: Ìyàn rẹ̀ sí ọ́fíìsì Ààrẹ fi ìkó àwọn aláàbò ara sí gbogbo iṣẹ́ ìjọba sí àárín ojúṣe rẹ̀. State House ní kí ó mú àìní àti èrò àwọn aláàbò ara wọ inú ètò àti ìlànà ìjọba àpapọ̀, ní ìfọwọ́sowọ́pọ̀ pẹ̀lú àwọn ìpínlẹ̀ àti National Commission for Persons with Disabilities. Èyí fún ìpolongo rẹ̀ ní ipa nínú bí àwọn ilé-iṣẹ́ ìjọba ṣe ń ṣètò fún àǹfààní àti ìwọlé.
text.ig: Nhọpụta ya n’ụlọ ọrụ onye isi ala tinyere nsonye ndị nwere nkwarụ n’ọrụ gọọmenti niile n’etiti ọrụ ya. State House nyere ya ọrụ itinye mkpa na echiche ndị nwere nkwarụ n’atụmatụ na mmemme gọọmenti etiti, ya na steeti na National Commission for Persons with Disabilities. Nke a na-enye nkwado ya ọrụ n’otú ụlọ ọrụ ọha si eme atụmatụ maka ohere na nsonye.

text.en: His office’s work with the Nigeria Women Economic Development Project (NigWED) connected disability inclusion with menstrual health and practical skills. In a July 2024 report from Karon-majigi, Abuja, the office described training women with disabilities to produce reusable sanitary pads. Isa’s address linked the initiative to dignity, access and enterprise. The account documents a training partnership; it does not establish participants’ later earnings or employment.
text.ha: Aikin ofishinsa tare da Nigeria Women Economic Development Project (NigWED) ya haɗa shigar da masu nakasa da lafiyar haila da ƙwarewar sana’a. A rahoton Yuli 2024 daga Karon-majigi, Abuja, ofishin ya bayyana horar da mata masu nakasa wajen ƙera kayan tsaftar haila da ake sake amfani da su. A jawabinsa, Isa ya danganta shirin da mutunci, samun dama da sana’a. Rahoton ya nuna haɗin gwiwar horo; bai tabbatar da kuɗin shiga ko aikin yi na mahalarta daga baya ba.
text.yo: Iṣẹ́ ọ́fíìsì rẹ̀ pẹ̀lú Nigeria Women Economic Development Project (NigWED) so ìkó àwọn aláàbò ara sí mọ́ ìlera nǹkan oṣù àti ọgbọ́n iṣẹ́. Nínú ìròyìn Oṣù keje 2024 láti Karon-majigi, Abuja, ọ́fíìsì ṣàlàyé ìkọ́ni fún àwọn obìnrin aláàbò ara láti ṣe aṣọ ìtọ́jú nǹkan oṣù tí a lè tún lò. Ọ̀rọ̀ Isa so ètò náà mọ́ iyì, àǹfààní àti òwò. Ìròyìn náà ṣe àkọsílẹ̀ àjọṣepọ̀ ìdánilẹ́kọ̀ọ́; kò fi owó tí àwọn olùkópa rí tàbí iṣẹ́ wọn lẹ́yìn náà múlẹ̀.
text.ig: Ọrụ ụlọ ọrụ ya na Nigeria Women Economic Development Project (NigWED) jikọtara nsonye ndị nwere nkwarụ na ahụike ịhụ nsọ na nkà ọrụ. N’akụkọ Julaị 2024 sitere na Karon-majigi, Abuja, ụlọ ọrụ ahụ kọwara ọzụzụ ụmụnwaanyị nwere nkwarụ imepụta akwa ịhụ nsọ a na-eji ọzọ. Okwu Isa jikọtara atụmatụ ahụ na ugwu, ohere na azụmahịa. Akụkọ ahụ dekọrọ mmekorita ọzụzụ; ọ naghị egosi ego ndị sonyere nwetara ma ọ bụ ọrụ ha mgbe e mesịrị.

title.en: Access to learning and better information
title.yo: Àǹfààní ẹ̀kọ́ àti ìsọfúnni tó dára sí i
title.ig: Ohere agụmakwụkwọ na ozi ka mma

text.en: His education advocacy has emphasised teachers equipped to support learners with disabilities. Alongside this, he has spoken about the need to understand the people public programmes are meant to serve. In his May 2025 interview with TheCable, he described work with stakeholders towards a centralised disability database and consultations with disabled people’s organisations. These were reported efforts and priorities, rather than evidence of a completed database or universal access.
text.ha: Fafutukarsa kan ilimi ta jaddada malamai masu ƙwarewar tallafa wa ɗalibai masu nakasa. Ya kuma yi magana kan buƙatar fahimtar mutanen da shirye-shiryen jama’a ke nufin tallafa wa. A hirarsa da TheCable a Mayu 2025, ya bayyana aiki tare da masu ruwa da tsaki domin samar da kundin bayanan masu nakasa na bai ɗaya, da tattaunawa da ƙungiyoyin masu nakasa. Waɗannan ayyuka da fifiko ne da aka ruwaito, ba shaidar kammala kundin bayanai ko samun dama ga kowa ba.
text.yo: Ìpolongo ẹ̀kọ́ rẹ̀ ti tẹnumọ́ olùkọ́ tó ní ọgbọ́n láti ṣètìlẹ́yìn fún akẹ́kọ̀ọ́ aláàbò ara. Ó tún ti sọ̀rọ̀ nípa àìní láti lóye àwọn tí ètò ìjọba fẹ́ sìn. Nínú ìfọ̀rọ̀wánilẹ́nuwò rẹ̀ pẹ̀lú TheCable ní Oṣù karùn-ún 2025, ó ṣàlàyé iṣẹ́ pẹ̀lú àwọn alábàáṣiṣẹ́ sí ibi ìkójọ dátà aláàbò ara kan ṣoṣo àti ìjíròrò pẹ̀lú àwọn àjọ aláàbò ara. Ìsapá àti ohun tó ṣe pàtàkì tí a ròyìn ni wọ́n, kì í ṣe ẹ̀rí ibi dátà tó ti parí tàbí àǹfààní fún gbogbo ènìyàn.
text.ig: Nkwado agụmakwụkwọ ya ekwusila ike na ndị nkuzi nwere nkà ịkwado ụmụ akwụkwọ nwere nkwarụ. O kwukwara mkpa ịghọta ndị mmemme ọha bu n’obi ijere ozi. N’ajụjụ ọnụ ya na TheCable na Mee 2025, ọ kọwara ọrụ ya na ndị metụtara ya imepụta otu ebe nchekwa data ndị nwere nkwarụ na mkparịta ụka ya na òtù ndị nwere nkwarụ. Ndị a bụ mbọ na ihe ndị e nyere mkpa a kọrọ, ọ bụghị ihe akaebe na e mechara ebe nchekwa data ma ọ bụ na onye ọ bụla nwetara ohere.
